title: Expert Explain Anything
prompt: Explain [TOPIC] as if you are a world-class expert but talking to a complete beginner. Use simple analogies, avoid jargon, and give 3 practical examples. End with the 3 most important takeaways.

title: Summarize Any Text
prompt: Summarize the following text in exactly 5 bullet points. Each bullet should be one sentence. Focus on the most important information. Text: [PASTE TEXT HERE]

title: Debug My Code
prompt:
I have a bug in my [LANGUAGE] code. Here is the code:

[PASTE CODE]

The expected behavior is: [WHAT IT SHOULD DO]
The actual behavior is: [WHAT IT DOES INSTEAD]

Please: 1) Find the bug 2) Explain why it's happening 3) Show the fixed code 4) Suggest how to prevent this in future

title: Code Review Expert
prompt:
Review this [LANGUAGE] code as a senior engineer. Check for: 1) Bugs and errors 2) Security vulnerabilities 3) Performance issues 4) Code readability 5) Best practice violations. Provide specific line-by-line feedback and an improved version.

[PASTE CODE]

title: Study Plan Generator
prompt: Create a detailed 30-day study plan for [SUBJECT/EXAM]. I have [X hours] per day available. Include: daily topics, resources to use, practice questions, revision schedule, and tips for retention. Format as a table.

title: Essay Writer Framework
prompt: Help me write an essay on: [TOPIC]. Word count: [NUMBER]. Format: Introduction (hook + thesis), 3 body paragraphs (claim + evidence + analysis), Conclusion (restate thesis + call to action). Academic level: [HIGH SCHOOL/COLLEGE]. Tone: [FORMAL/SEMI-FORMAL]

title: Business Plan Outline
prompt: Create a comprehensive business plan outline for: [BUSINESS IDEA]. Target market: [AUDIENCE]. Budget: [AMOUNT]. Include: Executive summary, Market analysis, Product/service description, Revenue model, Marketing strategy, Financial projections, Risk analysis.

title: Cold Email Generator
prompt: Write a cold outreach email to [TARGET PERSON/COMPANY] for [PURPOSE]. Keep it under 150 words. Include: Personalized opening, Clear value proposition, Specific pain point you solve, One concrete result/case study, Simple CTA. Tone: Professional but friendly.

title: Role Play Expert Consultant
prompt: Act as a [EXPERT TYPE: e.g., 'seasoned financial advisor', 'Fortune 500 CMO', 'Silicon Valley CTO']. I will ask you questions and you will answer from that expert's perspective, drawing on your hypothetical 20+ years of experience. First question: [YOUR QUESTION]

title: Build Full REST API
prompt: Build a complete REST API for [APP TYPE] using [TECHNOLOGY STACK]. Include: Authentication (JWT), CRUD endpoints for [RESOURCES], Input validation, Error handling, Rate limiting, API documentation. Generate all files with proper folder structure and comments.

title: Concept Flashcard Creator
prompt: Create 20 flashcards for studying [TOPIC]. Format each as: Front: [Clear question or term] Back: [Concise answer, max 2 sentences]. Include: Key definitions, Important formulas, Common examples. Organize by difficulty: Easy (7 cards), Medium (8 cards), Hard (5 cards).

title: SWOT Analysis Generator
prompt: Conduct a thorough SWOT analysis for [COMPANY/PRODUCT/IDEA]. Be specific and actionable. For each category provide 5 points with brief explanation. End with 3 strategic recommendations based on the analysis.
